BLOCKER: AC-1 requires persistence but design_pack.contracts.db = 'N/A' and api = 'N/A'; no store, owner, or write path is specified, so the AC cannot be met as designed.
AC-2 requires the endpoint in OpenAPI, yet api_contract spec_pack is marked 'N/A' ('no API change') — contract and AC directly contradict; needs_api is undecided.
Design leaves in_scope/affected_components/affected_files/risks as 'Not specified.' — no declared files to review against; scope guard and CL-016 cannot pass.
MAJOR: Language rule unresolved: new shipped endpoint logic must be Go, but test plan only names 'pytest focused tests'; design never states implementation language for the write API.
Authorization is only 'tooling-only' / 'operator role' prose; no authn mechanism, authz enforcement point, tenant scoping, or RLS posture (CL-011 unaddressed).
No idempotency/concurrency design for 'stale revisions' handling (optimistic concurrency, revision key, ordering invariant) despite FR-1 naming it; checklist item 5 unmet.
'does not introduce a duplicate store' AC has no named existing owner/port to reuse; reuse decision (checklist 10) is unspecified.
Observability reduced to 'tests'; no metrics/logs/trace signals to diagnose write failures at runtime (checklist 10).
Reversibility/rollback is only 'revert branch'; no statement on persisted data written by the endpoint if the change is reverted (checklist 1).
MINOR: failure_matrix has a single case ('missing evidence' → EVIDENCE_MISSING); malformed pack, missing role, and stale revision failures are not enumerated (checklist 6/8).
All traceability/evidence points at one doc (docs/IMPLEMENTATION-CONTROLS-DESIGN.md) for design, test, and evidence — weak separation of proof artifacts (CL-010).
spec_pack marks rollback_dr, migration_backfill, and observability_runbook as N/A despite an endpoint that writes data; migration/backup path unaddressed (checklist 1/6).
NIT: FR titles are truncated mid-sentence ('rejects malformed packs, missing operator ro'), reducing review clarity.
functional_spec assumptions reference 'develop has shared review decisions API' as an undeclared dependency risk (risks = 'Not specified.').
SUMMARY: Design is a placeholder shell: contracts say API/DB are 'N/A' while the ACs demand a persisted, OpenAPI-published endpoint — the approved AC cannot be met from this design.
Top risks: undefined store and API contract, unspecified language (Go rule), absent authz/tenant/RLS posture, and no reuse/observability/rollback design for a data-writing endpoint.
Recommend Gate-1 rejection until scope, affected files, API/DB contracts, auth boundary, and red proof for the real entrypoint are filled in.
